name: GlobalSecureAccessM365Profile
label: Manage the Microsoft 365 traffic forwarding profile
helpText: Controls the Microsoft 365 traffic forwarding profile - the part of Global Secure Access that acquires Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams traffic on devices running the Global Secure Access client. Enable it for all users, or restrict it to selected groups (a pilot); groups an administrator assigned by hand are always left alone. Nothing routes without the client, but on client-equipped devices enabling or disabling this profile changes whether their Microsoft 365 traffic is acquired. Prerequisite: the tenant must be onboarded to Global Secure Access (enable 'Onboard Global Secure Access' first). Graded from the daily Global Secure Access cache collection - run a Global Secure Access cache sync for an immediate re-grade. Do not combine a Disabled profile state with 'Require a compliant network (Global Secure Access)': that standard enables this profile and the two will keep flipping it.
executiveText: Controls which staff have their Microsoft 365 traffic (email, file and collaboration services) routed through the company's cloud network security service on managed devices: everyone, or a selected pilot group while it is proven out.
docsDescription: Grades the Microsoft 365 traffic forwarding profile from the NetworkAccess cache: its state, every policy link, and its assignmentRules - AllMembership (all users) or EnumeratedMembership (users, groups, devices), the surface the Global Secure Access portal's User and device assignments blade reads and writes. The expected state is conditional - Disabled grades the profile state alone; CustomGroups additionally grades that every configured group holds an assignment, additively (assignments made by hand are never drift and never removed). Remediation reads live state and writes only what differs through the same forwarding profile PATCH the portal uses: the profile state, each disabled policy link, and the assignmentRules. The legacy enterprise-app assignment flag is deliberately untouched.

assignedGroups.label: Group names to assign the profile to (when 'Selected groups' is chosen)
